overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long BE Daily ETF (BEX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Bloom Energy Corp. stock (BE) BEX was launched on Nov 12, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
